using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Plugins.Web.Bing;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Plugins.Web.Brave;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Plugins.Web.Google;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Plugins.Web.Tavily;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Tests.Plugins.Web;

public class WebServiceCollectionExtensionsTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void AddBingTextSearch_RegistersService_WithProvidedOptions()
    {
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var apiKey = "test-api-key";
        var options = new BingTextSearchOptions { /* set properties if any */ };

        services.AddBingTextSearch(apiKey, options);

        var provider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var textSearch = provider.GetService<ITextSearch>();
        Assert.Null(textSearch); // Because AddKeyedSingleton registers keyed, not default

        // Instead, resolve keyed service by default key (null)
        var keyed = provider.GetService<ITextSearch>();
        Assert.Null(keyed); // No default registration, so null

        // We test the factory delegate indirectly by resolving the keyed service via the service provider
        // But since AddKeyedSingleton is not standard, we test the factory delegate by invoking it manually

        var factory = GetFactoryFromServiceCollection(services, typeof(ITextSearch));
        Assert.NotNull(factory);

        var spMock = new ServiceCollection()
            .AddSingleton(options)
            .BuildServiceProvider();

        var instance = factory(spMock, null);
        Assert.NotNull(instance);
        Assert.IsType<BingTextSearch>(instance);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddBraveTextSearch_RegistersService_WithNullOptions_UsesServiceProvider()
    {
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var apiKey = "test-api-key";

        services.AddBraveTextSearch(apiKey);

        var provider = services.BuildServiceProvider();

        var factory = GetFactoryFromServiceCollection(services, typeof(ITextSearch));
        Assert.NotNull(factory);

        var braveOptions = new BraveTextSearchOptions();
        var spMock = new ServiceCollection()
            .AddSingleton(braveOptions)
            .BuildServiceProvider();

        var instance = factory(spMock, null);
        Assert.NotNull(instance);
        Assert.IsType<BraveTextSearch>(instance);
    }

    private static Func<IServiceProvider, object?, ITextSearch>? GetFactoryFromServiceCollection(IServiceCollection services, Type serviceType)
    {
        // The AddKeyedSingleton extension method is not standard, so we cannot resolve the factory directly.
        // We simulate by finding the registration and extracting the factory delegate from the implementation factory.
        foreach (var descriptor in services)
        {
            if (descriptor.ServiceType == serviceType && descriptor.ImplementationFactory != null)
            {
                var factory = descriptor.ImplementationFactory;
                return (sp, obj) => (ITextSearch)factory(sp);
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
}
